baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual links يُؤْمِنُونَ بالله والنبي وما أنزل إليه directly to ما اتخذوهم أولياء.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith is heart-settling assent to God, the divine reporter, and delivered revelation; deliberately acquiring a relation of alliance and support is therefore treated as evidence against that settled configuration.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inner condition tested by the social relation.
The one reporting from God gives faith a mediated, message-bearing object.
Caused descent and delivery make revelation something received rather than self-produced.
Acquisition for oneself makes the relation a chosen installation rather than an accidental contact.
Love, support, and alliance specify the installed relation whose compatibility with faith is denied.

changed_reading.before: Belief and taking allies were two assertions placed beside one another.
changed_reading.after: The counterfactual makes chosen alliance a diagnostic enactment: settled assent to God, the prophet, and delivered revelation would reorganize whom one installs as supporter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired forms اتخذوهم and أولياء combine acquisition with uninterrupted nearness and charge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The objects are not merely liked; they are made one's own as proximate parties who can support or stand over an affair. The focus tests an allocated social office or allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies deliberate allocation.
Nearness without an intervening gap supplies the relation's spatial and social immediacy.
Standing over and administering an affair supplies the possible governance dimension.

changed_reading.before: أولياء was a broad label for friends.
changed_reading.after: أولياء can denote deliberately installed proximity, support, or charge, making the criticized act more structured than ordinary friendliness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The turn from لو كانوا يؤمنون to ولكن كثيرا منهم فاسقون contrasts settled security with many exiting a containing boundary.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith offers a settled interior, while فسق contributes the material image of ripe fruit leaving its skin. كثرة scales that breach from an isolated lapse to a prevalent group condition.

activation_trace.role: Security and heart-settling trust supply the stable interior from which the contrast begins.
Numerical growth turns the breach into a prevalent pattern among them.
A ripe fruit exiting its skin supplies the concrete image of crossing out of a containing norm.

changed_reading.before: فاسقون was only a settled moral classification.
changed_reading.after: It also pictures a widespread boundary event: people leave the containing integrity that settled trust would have maintained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier repeated taking/awliya construction identifies the relevant actors by what they do to دين: obedience is converted into mockery and purposeless play. This narrows the installed relation from generic contact to empowered proximity with agents who trivialize the community's governing commitment.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate acquisition anchors the changed reading in the focus act.
Standing over an affair supplies the empowered proximity being allocated.
Obedience and submission identify what the targeted conduct treats as an object.
Mockery supplies the first mode by which that obedience is publicly devalued.
Action without a sound purpose supplies the second mode of trivialization.

structural_cues: 5:57 repeats لا تتخذوا ... أولياء, while 5:59 repeats faith, descent, كثرة, and فسق before the focus restates the cluster.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated construction and the obedience/mockery/play images; I infer that trivialization explains why the installed relation contradicts faith, while a live alternative is that these are adjacent qualifications rather than a causal rationale.

changed_reading.before: The focus could be heard as barring any friendship with an undifferentiated group.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses acquiring empowered proximity with actors characterized here by turning obedience into mockery and purposeless play; ordinary contact is not the operative mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shell-exit image of فسق becomes a permeability process: a verbal profession accompanies entry with concealed disbelief and exit with it, then appears publicly as haste toward conduct that strips value away, without effective restraint by learned authorities.

activation_trace.role: Exit from a skin anchors the focus label as a breached boundary rather than a static tag.
Literal entry supplies the inbound phase of the boundary sequence.
Passing outward supplies the matching outbound phase without inner change.
Concealment explains how the incompatible interior can traverse the professed boundary.
Speed against slowness turns the breach into an observable behavioral acceleration.
Stripping and eradication give the public conduct a materially consuming effect.
Restraint from action supplies the missing institutional check on the breach.

structural_cues: 5:61 moves through profession, entry, concealment, and exit; 5:62 makes the resulting conduct visible; 5:63 asks why authorities do not restrain it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies movement, concealment, haste, stripping, and absent restraint; I infer a temporal path from concealed profession to public practice and institutional failure, while these may instead be parallel symptoms with no strict causal order.

changed_reading.before: Many being فاسقون named a private or doctrinal defect.
changed_reading.after: Their فسق is legible as a repeated breach system: an unchanged concealed interior crosses a verbal boundary, accelerates into damaging practice, and persists because restraint fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent does not automatically equal believing reception. The context sets two trajectories around the same revelation: establish it and transmit it to its destination, or have its arrival increase limit-breaking. The focus condition يؤمنون ... بما أنزل names the successful reception, not bare exposure.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent anchors the receptive outcome required by the focus counterfactual.
Delivered descent supplies the message whose reception can follow different trajectories.
Shell-exit anchors the failed trajectory as movement beyond a containing limit.
The same delivered revelation reappears as the input that does not guarantee assent.
Growth supplies the directional change by which reception intensifies an existing disposition.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience names the first mapped image of failed reception.
The second mapped inventory independently preserves limit-exceeding as the failed trajectory.
Straightening and establishing supply the enacted alternative to merely encountering revelation.
Carrying the message through to its destination supplies the transmission stage of successful delivery.

structural_cues: 5:65-66 repeat the لو counterfactual and attach faith and establishing revelation to changed outcomes.
5:64 and 5:68 repeat revelation increasing many in transgression and covering, with 5:67 placing complete transmission between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, establishment, transmission, increase, and limit-exceeding; I infer a reception fork in which enacted establishment mediates between delivery and faith, while an alternative is that revelation only exposes an already fixed disposition rather than changing it.

changed_reading.before: Believing in what descended meant acknowledging that revealed content exists.
changed_reading.after: It means completing a reception trajectory in which delivered revelation is settled, established, and allowed to govern; the same arrival can instead disclose or intensify movement beyond its limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places two binding acts in tension: a covenant is taken, yet desire becomes the followed sequence, obedience is exited, and mutual restraint disappears. Taking awliya can therefore function as installing a rival chain of custody and following in place of the covenant-message chain.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring for oneself anchors the focus as a choice of binding arrangement.
Unbroken succession supplies the chain-like structure of the chosen allegiance.
Taking and holding supplies the mirrored act by which the covenant is made binding.
The confirmed covenant supplies the prior binding relation against which later allegiance is measured.
The soul's inclination supplies the pressure that rejects messages not matching it.
Allegiance and succession convert inclination into a repeatable following relation.
Repeated inward inclination identifies what the rival sequence follows.
Exit from obedience states the result of replacing the covenant's demand.
Absent reciprocal restraint shows the rival sequence becoming socially self-maintaining.

structural_cues: 5:70 begins with taking a covenant and repeatedly receiving messengers; 5:77-79 end with following desires, disobedience, and failure to restrain one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored taking, a binding covenant, desire-following, exited obedience, and absent restraint; I infer substitution of one governing chain for another, while a live alternative is that alliance is only one downstream symptom of covenant failure rather than its replacement.

changed_reading.before: Taking awliya was an isolated social choice.
changed_reading.after: It can be a rival binding sequence: chosen proximity institutionalizes whom desire follows after the covenant-message sequence has lost practical control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene repeats many among them and the same w-l-y relation, then calls it what their own selves advanced for them and gives it a clinging outcome. The focus counterfactual becomes an explanation of a self-authored, temporally durable alignment.

activation_trace.role: Alliance and support anchor the focus explanation in the exact relation observed just before it.
Numerical prevalence supplies the immediately repeated group scale.
Active alliance supplies the observed conduct that the focus counterfactual diagnoses.
Advancing forward gives the alliance a prospective, consequence-bearing direction.
The self itself assigns authorship of the advanced act to those making the alignment.
Displeasure opposite approval supplies the evaluative reversal produced by that choice.
Clinging and continued attachment supply the durable endpoint of the trajectory.

structural_cues: 5:80 and 5:81 are adjacent and repeat كثيرا منهم plus the w-l-y relation; observation is followed by a لو counterfactual diagnosis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, lexical repetition, self-advancement, displeasure, and clinging; I infer that 5:81 explains the observed alignment as a durable self-authored trajectory, while it could instead be a moral diagnosis without a developed causal timeline.

changed_reading.before: The criticized relation was a present attitude or association.
changed_reading.after: It is a deliberate act the self sends ahead, installing an alignment whose effects adhere; the absence of settled faith explains that temporal commitment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following passage uses separate roots to praise closeness and affection, then depicts unarrogant hearing, recognition of descended truth, and professed faith. This differentiates qurb and wudd from the deliberately installed w-l-y relation and makes response to revelation, not a group label alone, decisive.

activation_trace.role: Standing over an affair anchors the criticized relation as more structured than mere emotional nearness.
Settled assent remains the focus criterion by which the contrasting response is read.
Nearness against distance supplies a positively marked relation distinct from w-l-y.
Love and affection supply the positive affect that cannot simply be equated with the focus prohibition.
Absence of self-greatness supplies the posture that permits receptive movement.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies reception rather than mere acoustic exposure.
The same delivered descent supplies the object that now reaches a receptive audience.
Recognition through a distinguishing trace supplies the cognitive turn toward truth.
Professed settled assent completes the contrasting reception sequence.

structural_cues: 5:82 moves from hostility to closest affection within named populations; 5:83-84 then narrate hearing, recognition, faith, and hope for entry among the صالحين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct relation-roots and a positive reception sequence; I infer that their lexical contrast limits awliya to a more governing allegiance than every form of affection, while the alternative is that 5:82 only describes disposition and does not itself define permissible alliance.

changed_reading.before: The focus seemed to condemn closeness or affection according to a fixed communal label.
changed_reading.after: It distinguishes installed allegiance from affection and proximity: members of a named population can approach, love, hear, recognize, and believe, so revelatory response rather than label alone controls the diagnosis.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it promotes the form-distant road branch of نبي and gait branch of أخذ into one mechanism. It remains packet-anchored because the focus also supplies ordered descent and succession, while 5:77 explicitly supplies following, inclination, an even course, and a path. Render it only as route imagery that may illuminate social imitation, not as replacement lexicography or settled exegesis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: النبي, ما أنزل, اتخذوهم, and أولياء can form a route-and-succession cluster inside 5:81.

activation_trace.role: A clear road leading to a destination turns the prophet anchor into route imagery.
Putting a thing in its proper station supplies ordered placement along that route.
Adopting a people's gait, form, or conduct supplies the imitative mechanism.
One thing following another without interruption supplies the rival succession.
Following behind supplies an explicit contextual enactment of route imitation.
Inward inclination supplies what steers the following sequence.
A middle, just course supplies the route from which the sequence departs.
An extended traversable path makes the contextual route explicit.

changed_reading.before: Taking awliya concerned only choosing patrons.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also picture adopting a rival gait and uninterrupted sequence instead of letting the prophet-road and properly placed revelation set one's course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it combines the water-holding and following-rain branches of focus words with later tears and rivers. It remains anchored in descent, taking, awliya, and shell-exit, and the context supplies actual overflow and flow. Downstream prose must mark it as a material analogy for reception and transmission, not claim that the focus lexemes literally denote a hydraulic system.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ما أنزل, اتخذوهم, أولياء, and فاسقون admit a contained material analogy of descent, holding, sequence, and boundary rupture.

activation_trace.role: Descent and settling supply the incoming material in the reception analogy.
A basin that holds water supplies a form-distant image for acquired containment.
Rain following earlier rain supplies sequenced replenishment to the chosen relation.
Fruit breaking out of its skin supplies the failed container boundary.
Easy abundant overflow supplies a contrasting receptive release.
A vessel filling until it spills supplies the threshold between reception and outward response.
Ongoing flow supplies the downstream continuation of receptive overflow.
A river cutting a channel through earth completes the contextual flow image.

changed_reading.before: The conditional contrasted correct belief with a wrong social choice.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it contrasts failed holding that ends in boundary rupture with reception that fills, overflows, and continues along an open channel.

strongest_changes: The repeated taking/awliya construction makes the focus a diagnosis of deliberately installed alliance or charge, not generic affection.
Revelation becomes a reception fork: established and transmitted descent can settle as faith, while the same arrival can disclose or increase limit-breaking.
The post-focus contrast distinguishes criticized w-l-y from closeness and affection, and makes actual response to descended truth more decisive than a group label.
summary.what_was_special: The trace was driven by unusually tight recurrences: the exact many-plus-w-l-y scene in 5:80, the counterfactual and revelation fork in 5:64-68, the covenant-versus-desire sequence in 5:70-79, and the positive qurb/wudd reception sequence immediately after the focus.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise antecedent and social scope of the focus pronouns remain underdetermined by branch activation alone.
The w-l-y inventory keeps support, affection, proximity, and governance live; context narrows them but does not force one exclusive English rendering.
The increase caused by revelation may be causal intensification or revelatory exposure of an existing disposition.
The route and hydrological outliers are analogical activations and should not displace the stronger social and reception models.
